analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 81,100) vs SMA5/20/50 (KRW 93,063/105,372/104,148): Below short/mid-term moving averages, bearish.
· Significantly lower than SMA100/200 (KRW 137,273/111,338): Mid-to-long-term trend weakening.
· 52-week position (21.9%): Current price level is high relative to the 52-week low but historically very low relative to the high.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (51.5 → 30.0): Entering oversold territory, downward momentum strengthening.
· MACD histogram trajectory (665.4716 → -3227.9465): Turned negative and continues to worsen, confirming bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower band KRW 85,806): Approaching the lower band, suggesting potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support level (KRW 68,045): Significant downside potential relative to current price.
· Swing resistance level (KRW 95,500): Significant upside resistance zone relative to current price.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower High): Confirms continuation of downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.09x): Volume increase is minimal compared to recent volatility, lacking momentum for trend reversal.
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend): Sell-side dominance due to RSI entering oversold and MACD continuing to worsen. Caution advised due to non-trending ADX (14.7) and potential for sharp volatility; maintain a wait-and-see approach.
